defense_news.title: DOGE said it saved $1.7 billion by terminating a military health IT contract. GAO found the contract was never terminated.
defense_news.summary: DOGE reported $1.76 billion in savings from terminating a contract, but GAO found that the contract was never terminated and no funds were deobligated.

defense_news.title: DARPA developing hypersonic cruise missile to evade enemy air defenses
defense_news.summary: DARPA is developing a hypersonic cruise missile in response to the Pentagon's concerns that American missiles are vulnerable to enemy air defenses.

defense_news.title: USS Theodore Roosevelt becomes first carrier with built-in Unmanned Air Warfare Center
defense_news.summary: The USS Theodore Roosevelt is now the first Navy carrier to be equipped with an Unmanned Air Warfare Center that will support the unmanned MQ-25A Stingray.

defense_news.title: US Army exploring 50mm cannon to destroy drones
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army is looking for companies that can provide a 50mm cannon and ammunition capable of destroying a broad range of drones.
